title: System Settings
description: Global configuration for the ARISP platform (single-tenant)

auth.title: Allowed Email Domains
auth.description: List of company email domains allowed to sign in (Google OAuth + pre-provisioning).
auth.infoLine1End: (HR · Recruiter · Super Admin). Email + password sign-in and candidate accounts are not restricted by this list.
auth.infoLine2: Leave empty = allow all domains. After passing the domain check, accounts must still be pre-provisioned in the system.
auth.empty: No domains yet. When empty, all email domains will be blocked from Google sign-in.

interview.title: Interview location
interview.description: Printed in the interview invitation email (time — location — directions). One location is shared system-wide.
interview.addressPlaceholder: 3rd floor, ABC Building, 266 Doi Can, Ba Dinh, Hanoi
interview.addressHint: Include floor / building / street number so candidates can actually find it — not just the city.
interview.directionsPlaceholder: Enter the lobby, take lift L4 or L5 on the left, the room is right behind the reception desk.
interview.directionsHint: Optional. A couple of lines keeps candidates from getting lost in a large building.
interview.mapUrlHint: Optional. Paste a Google Maps link — the invitation shows it as a "view map" link.
interview.notice: Leave the address empty and the invitation drops the location line entirely — better missing than wrong. Online test rounds are taken remotely and ignore this.

descriptions.interview_location_address: Office address printed in interview invitations
descriptions.interview_location_map_url: Map link attached to interview invitations

integrations.title: Webhook & Integrations
integrations.description: Configure event destinations for ATS and internal notification channels.

descriptions.atsWebhookUrl: Webhook URL to send recruitment events to the ATS system.
descriptions.atsWebhookSecret: Secret key used to sign ATS webhook payloads.
descriptions.slackWebhookUrl: Incoming webhook to send notifications to Slack.
descriptions.teamsWebhookUrl: Incoming webhook to send notifications to Microsoft Teams.
